description: Fetch a web page in a real browser through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com) and return it as clean Markdown: the main content with absolute links, without scripts, styles, navigation or footer. Use it to read, quote or summarise a page; it is usually 2-25% the size of the HTML. Works on JavaScript-rendered pages and on pages that refuse ordinary fetches (403/429, captcha). Use fetch_html instead when you need the markup, selectors or browser steps. Billed as one request.

main_content_only.description: Drop navigation, page header, footer and sidebars (default true). False keeps the whole page.

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO country code to route through, e.g. 'US'.

sleep_seconds.description: Extra seconds to wait after load.

name: fetch_markdown
title: Fetch page as Markdown
